roadmap.goal: ADO Story 6095: Lighthouse takes its dependency updates from Renovate instead of Dependabot, under the same auto-merge-on-green rules; lighthouse-clients adopts the same auto-merge policy; the held-back MUI packages catch up to the latest 9.x. Acceptance: the two new guards in .github/scripts (action-pins, dependency-bot) go from skipped to GREEN against fixtures and the real repository, renovate.json passes renovate-config-validator --strict, and the frontend suite and build stay green after the MUI upgrade.

validation.notes: Built from feature-delta.md (DISCUSS D1-D9, DESIGN DES-1..DES-11, DEVOPS, DISTILL), acceptance/story-6095.feature, the three slice briefs, design/renovate.candidate.json, the RED scaffolds and tests in .github/scripts, and the one-time pin-conversion script in the session scratchpad.

user_decisions: Renovate replaces Dependabot in one change; the two bots never overlap (D1)
Everything auto-merges on green except the toolchain group, .NET runtime image majors and chart value updates (D2, DES-6)
Every Action pinned once as @sha # version by a throwaway script, not committed (DES-1)
Delete the dependabot[bot] actor guards; do not swap in renovate[bot] (DES-2)
lighthouse-clients auto-merges every update type and vulnerability alerts (D3, DES-10)
MUI holds carry over in slice 01 and are lifted by hand in slice 03 (D7, DES-11)
out_of_scope: Pushing anything: the orchestrator pauses before every push, and the slice 01 cutover commit must not reach main before the maintainer adds Lighthouse to the Renovate app selection
Repository settings: switching Dependabot security updates off, deleting DEPENDABOT_GITHUB_TOKEN and the Dependabot secret set (DES-9 steps 2, 3 and 6, orchestrator/maintainer after push)
@mui/lab (no stable v9), lighthouse-platform's Renovate config, schedules, lock-file maintenance
Mutation testing: DELIVER Phase 5, not roadmap steps (see mutation below)

Contract points from DISTILL Scaffolds: a pin is a 40-hex commit then `# <ref>` where ref is a release (v1.3, v6.0.2) or a branch label (stable); quoted pins and varying spaces around # are accepted; a shortened SHA or no ref is action-not-pinned; a bare SHA or empty comment is action-pin-unlabelled; commented-out lines are not read; reusable workflows from another repo by path are in scope. Style: mirror .github/scripts/toolchain-pins.mjs (tabs, ESM, node: built-ins only, small named functions, no CLI entry). Keep each function under cognitive complexity 15 and regexes simple (Sonar). Comments rare, plain language, no internal references (no D2, DES-1, AC-01.7, ADR-212, story or slice numbers) in code, test names or skip strings. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: node:test with property-style fixture tables authored in DISTILL; a pure read-only guard returning Violation[] is fully asserted per test, so no Hypothesis/state-delta harness applies. steps.implementation_notes: Script: /tmp/claude-1000/-storage-repos-Lighthouse/1572f593-3258-4026-b886-d812d4ed010e/scratchpad/pin-all-actions.sh. Run it, never copy it into the repository: `bash <script> /storage/repos/Lighthouse`. It needs `gh` authenticated (reads repos/<action>/tags, git/ref, commits). It rewrites only lines ending in `uses: owner/repo@<ref>` with nothing after the ref, so the 5 already-annotated refs are left alone. Counts may drift slightly if an upstream tag moved since DESIGN (e.g. sonarqube-quality-gate-action master no longer at a release gets labelled `# master`); both forms satisfy the guard - report any difference from 29/141 with the reason rather than hand-editing. dependabot-automerge.yaml gets converted too; it is deleted in 01-04, that is fine. If the guard still reports a violation after the script, STOP and report the line (do not hand-fix silently). This commit touches ci*.yml, which turns on every live connector suite in CI on push; that is expected and the orchestrator's concern. Commit (DES-9 a): `ci(actions): pin every action to a commit with its release named`.

Contract points: violation `{ rule, file, line?, message }`, line required for run-depends-on-actor; an `if: >-` spanning several lines is one condition (reported at the if: line); trailing `# ...` comments are not read; when renovate.json is missing or unparseable report exactly that one violation and skip hold checks; hold-without-reason messages mention `description`. Scope for if: scanning is YAML under .github/workflows and .github/actions, the same scope as action-pins: a small shared helper for listing those files is acceptable if both guards need it verbatim - if you add one, name the extra file in the report so the mutation config includes it; never import toolchain-pins internals. criteria: RED first: the two real-repository tests unskipped before the edits fail on second-bot-config, run-depends-on-actor and renovate-config-missing.

steps.implementation_notes: Copy the candidate with `cp`, do not retype it; do not reformat it (Biome does not cover the repo root JSON, but check no formatter touches it). In each workflow change exactly `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'` to `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`; leave the `username: ${{ github.actor }}` GHCR logins in ci_docker.yml and ci_release.yml untouched. README: replace the 'Dependabot:' block with a short 'Dependency updates' paragraph: Renovate (renovate.json at the root) proposes updates once a release is 7 days old and they merge themselves when the required checks pass, except the Node and pnpm toolchain group, .NET runtime image majors and chart value updates, which wait for a maintainer; security fixes skip the wait; a vulnerable indirect dependency gets no bot update and is caught by the pnpm audit on main, where a maintainer adds an override. Do not use the word Dependabot anywhere in the README (say 'GitHub's vulnerability alerts'). Also rewrite the 'Pinning external action SHAs' block: it points at Scripts/pin-action-shas.sh, which does not exist, and describes the bare-SHA form the new guard rejects; replace it with one or two lines saying every uses: is pinned as `@<sha> # <version>` so Renovate can update it, and the workflow-scripts check rejects any other form. While there, the `build-frontend` bullet's 'Node 20 + pnpm 9' is stale (Node comes from .nvmrc, pnpm from packageManager) - fix it in the same edit. Delete the constant once no test uses it. This commit must not reach main before the maintainer adds Lighthouse to the Renovate app; that is the orchestrator's push gate, not a crafter action. Commit (DES-9 b): `ci(deps): switch dependency updates from Dependabot to Renovate`. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: config and workflow edits verified by the real-repository guard tests and the Renovate validator.
